Features

Everything you make, in one calm place.

Four real editors, a library that ties them together, and the planning tools around them — designed to feel the same whether you’re jotting a note or building a deck.

Documents

Four kinds, each a proper editor.

Notes

Continuous, flowing pages. Link pages with [[ ]], add blocks with /, tick checklists that appear on your task board, embed live views, and keep version history.

Pages

True page layout: paper sizes, margins, headers, footers, page numbers, tables, pictures and shapes — saved as .docx. Spelling and grammar marks and AutoCorrect included.

Slides

Themes, layouts, shapes, pictures, tables, charts, speaker notes and a full-screen show with transitions — saved as .pptx. A bar follows the selected object with fill, outline, order and align.

Sheets

Formulas, tables, charts, pivot tables, drop-down lists, conditional colours, tick boxes and sparklines — saved as .xlsx. Import and export CSV.

Open real files

Open .docx, .pptx, .xlsx, .odt, .md, PDFs and more in place, and save back to the same file. Anything else opens in the app your system uses for it.

Templates

Over a hundred starting points for notes, pages, slides, sheets, whiteboards and databases. Browse them all.

Work side by side

Split view, tabs and pop-out windows.

Put two or three documents next to each other — a sheet beside a report, a deck beside your notes. Tabs that share a view carry the same colour and number, and every pane keeps its own toolbar. Pull a tab out to give a document its own window.

  • Ctrl+\ splits the view; drag the divider to resize
  • Right-click a tab to open it beside the current document
  • Right-click a file to open it with any app that can read it
How split view works
Write well

Spelling, grammar and AutoCorrect as you type.

A red dotted line marks a spelling mistake, a blue one a grammar problem. Right-click for suggestions, ignore a word or add it to your dictionary. Common typos fix themselves, a lone i becomes I, and sentences start with a capital.

  • Works offline — the dictionary is built in
  • Switch it off any time from the ••• menu
  • Pages and Slides have AutoCorrect too
Plan & connect

The tools around your documents.

Everything shares one library, so a document can be a task, an event, a card on a whiteboard or a row in a database.

Tasks

Boards, lists, tables and timelines; projects, epics, sprints, releases, reports and automations. Tasks & Calendar

Calendar

Day to month views, drag and drop, feeds from Outlook, Google and iCloud, and a meeting note, minutes page or briefing deck in one click.

Whiteboards

A real diagram editor with 60 shapes, smart connectors, auto layout and draw.io import — and 28 templates.

Databases

Turn pages into tables, boards, calendars, charts and forms, with formulas, relations and rollups — and 16 templates.

Goals

Objectives and key results with health that tracks the clock — a key result can read a number from a sheet cell.

Insights

See what needs review, what has gone stale, what links where — filtered by kind of document.

Accessibility & comfort

Easy to read, easy to use.

Display choices

Text size up to 150%, higher contrast, a readable typeface, relaxed line spacing and a simple view with less on screen.

Keyboard first

Shortcuts for everything, a command bar (Ctrl+Shift+P), a strong focus outline option and bigger click targets.

Calm motion

Gentle transitions that stop entirely with one switch (or your system’s Reduce motion setting). Autosave is always on.

20 themes, five colours each

Light, dark and coloured themes — every one a full palette that colours icons, buttons and charts.

Local and private

No account, no cloud, no telemetry. Read how your data is stored.

Exports that match

PDF, Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Markdown and HTML, saved wherever you choose — and tracked on the Files page.
